warning: Cyberpunk 2077 starts by itself with -benchmark (the argument the Phoronix Test Suite uses): the game loads straight into its built-in benchmark, the app waits up to 10 minutes for the result file and then closes the game. Do not use the computer meanwhile.
notes: Verified on 2026-10-18 with the owner present (session 4, game version 2.31, RTX 5090 Laptop, 2560x1440): the game is started directly (bin/x64/Cyberpunk2077.exe with the arguments, so Steam asks nothing), summary.json was written to Documents\CD Projekt Red\Cyberpunk 2077 enchmarkResults enchmark_<date>\, Data.averageFps / minFps / maxFps were read (76.43 / 65.57 / 104.37 FPS) and the app closed the game. -skipStartScreen did not skip the 'press to continue' screen in 2.31: the user presses a key there, then starts the benchmark from the menu. No keys are sent. If the file or its keys differ, the run is 'invalid' (never a 0). Frame times by PresentMon are a separate capture (Frame capture tab). Since 2026-10-18 the run is automatic: -benchmark is passed so the game starts the benchmark by itself (to be confirmed on a real run).
